prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Create a website masthead art asset, NOT a screenshot or web page. Wide 3:1 landscape. Intricate antique steel-engraving drawing of Colorado Rocky Mountain peaks, foothills, scattered pines and a rustic split-rail fence in the foreground, matching an elegant community newspaper. Tall alpine mountains span the full width; largest peaks near center and right. No buildings. Fine crosshatching in muted slate navy #24344B and silver #AEB6C1 on near-white #f8f8f7 paper. Very pale empty sky, artwork fades delicately to blank paper at outer edges. Shallow panoramic composition for a 900 by 220 pixel header. No text, labels, border or watermark.

Use case: illustration-story. Create a standalone website illustration, NOT a screenshot or web page. Landscape 2:1 composition. Elegant antique steel-engraving drawing of a quiet outdoor neighborhood swimming pool with lounge chairs and open white parasols along the far edge, Colorado foothills, mature pines and a partial clubhouse at the far right, no people. Match a refined community newspaper's detailed hand engraved crosshatching in muted slate navy #24344B and silver #AEB6C1 with a subtle pale teal #4F7D7B wash only in the water. Near-white #f8f8f7 paper background, edges dissolve softly into the paper especially along the bottom. Pool occupies lower half of image, parasols and pines fill upper half. No text, labels, border or watermark.
